research_question: Why does categorical Panchang representation alter PV forecasting performance differently across model architectures and forecast horizons?

mechanisms.dimension_or_flexibility: The F3->F4 effect is largely explained by adding a 97-dimensional categorical basis rather than by correct Panchang alignment.
mechanisms.aligned_structure: Correct timestamp-aligned Panchang structure contributes predictive information beyond dimensionality alone.
mechanisms.coding_sensitivity: Part of the effect, especially for linear models, may depend on the full one-hot coding convention.

frozen_phase1.test_reuse_status: Phase 2A is a post-Phase1 mechanistic follow-up on SOLETE. SOLETE test results are not treated as a new independent confirmatory test.

core_variants.F4_real: F3 + correctly aligned 97-column Panchang one-hot block.
core_variants.F4_shift_17d: F3 + Panchang block circularly shifted 17 days within each split.
core_variants.F4_shift_37d: F3 + Panchang block circularly shifted 37 days within each split.
core_variants.F4_shift_61d: F3 + Panchang block circularly shifted 61 days within each split.
core_variants.F4_perm_1301: F3 + joint Panchang rows permuted within each split; seed 1301.
core_variants.F4_perm_1302: F3 + joint Panchang rows permuted within each split; seed 1302.
core_variants.F4_perm_1303: F3 + joint Panchang rows permuted within each split; seed 1303.
core_variants.F4_reference: F3 + reference-coded Panchang block with one canonical indicator dropped from each of the five families.

initial_model_strata.reason: linear/regularized architecture; tests sensitivity to high-dimensional categorical basis

model_control_rule: For each model and horizon, use one fixed F4-selected architecture/hyperparameter configuration across F3 and every Phase-2 representation variant. Do not retune per variant.
interpretation_guardrails: No universal claim that F4 is superior.
SOLETE Phase-2 analysis is mechanistic/post-hoc relative to Phase 1.
External PVOD validation will be the independent generalization step.
Do not change variant definitions after seeing Phase-2 outcomes.
